parameters.query:
-- Booking als No-Show markieren + Client-Counter hochzählen
WITH updated_booking AS (
  UPDATE bookings
  SET status = 'no_show', updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = '{{ $json.body.booking_id }}'
    AND status = 'confirmed'
  RETURNING id, salon_id, client_id, service_id, start_time
),
updated_client AS (
  UPDATE clients
  SET no_show_count = no_show_count + 1,
      requires_prepayment = CASE WHEN no_show_count + 1 >= 3 THEN true ELSE requires_prepayment END,
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = (SELECT client_id FROM updated_booking)
  RETURNING id AS client_id, first_name, phone, no_show_count, requires_prepayment
)
SELECT
  ub.id AS booking_id,
  ub.salon_id,
  ub.start_time,
  uc.client_id,
  uc.first_name AS client_name,
  uc.phone AS client_phone,
  uc.no_show_count,
  uc.requires_prepayment,
  s.name AS service_name,
  sal.name AS salon_name
FROM updated_booking ub
JOIN updated_client uc ON uc.client_id = ub.client_id
JOIN services s ON s.id = ub.service_id
JOIN salons sal ON sal.id = ub.salon_id;

INSERT INTO message_log (salon_id, client_id, channel, direction, template_name, message_text, related_booking_id)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.salon_id }}',
  '{{ $json.client_id }}',
  'whatsapp',
  'outbound',
  'no_show_{{ $json.severity }}',
  '{{ $json.message }}',
  '{{ $json.booking_id }}'
);

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, no_show_count: $json.no_show_count, severity: $json.severity, requires_prepayment: $json.requires_prepayment, message_sent: true }) }}
